reviewed: Protocol/store/service/client/server ownership and the disposable rvoip projection.
Current authorization before mutation receipt replay; conflicting logical IDs; ambiguous inbound routing and revocation.
Observer cancellation, bounded teardown/draining, SDK input ownership and reliable terminal media events.

code_review.maintainability: Central operation/CLI/type facades are larger than focused media modules; the largest production file is the 733-line atomic store dispatcher. That transaction boundary was reviewed explicitly. Further splitting is a maintainability choice, not a claim that every file is small or that community review has already accepted the code.

known_limits: Local macOS arm64 only. Chrome uses loopback host/host UDP ICE; telephone tests use the recorded Telnyx registration/NAT path and owned receivers. WAN/TURN, mobile devices, arbitrary carriers and audio hardware are not qualified.
Model context has a 32 KiB item budget. Older sources remain in authorized history with explicit omission counts; automatic summaries and pinned-fact retrieval are future decisions.

The three required spoken decisions were recalled exactly after restart. A supplemental written-code assertion returned courts harbor instead of Quartz Harbor, following a phonetic telephone transcript. The original draft and transcript remain separate sources.
The first inbound attempt after a long idle/sleep period failed before answer. Fresh registration and a later idle-period retest succeeded; the original cause remains unproven.
Live SMS remains deferred pending carrier approval. MCP/skill, another assistant, task resumption, video and the complete v0.1 release remain assigned to later gates.
preserved_failures: Earlier provider chat input strategies rejected or ignored history; corrected prompt-variable path qualified.
Initial browser signaling race/cleanup and restricted route credential failures were fixed and retested.
Initial inbound before fresh registration and the earlier handset 603 rejection remain failures.
Early telephone receiver interruption and third-answer truncation are not three-turn passes; the tuned bounded receiver passed.
Two large provider HTTP reads failed before remote-end submission; explicit cleanup and a documented filtered read produced a passed installed-client remote-end test.
Concurrent Gate 2 debug init exceeded its deadline; isolated unchanged-source regression passed.
The supplemental exact written-code spelling assertion remains failed; all three required voice decisions passed.
The first documentation-bundle build collided with an existing directory before creating archives. A corrected clean revision built and passed all 10 installed checks.

completion_audit_gap.finding: Production Vapi/QUIC/media-graph queue defaults exceed the frozen 200 ms queued-audio budget; the pressure harness does not actually inject reordered RTP.
completion_audit_gap.disposition: Fix configuration/necessary pinned interface patches and add actual fault/budget evidence. Preserve thresholds and prior successful evidence.
